statement: Kernel state separates plugged/used/active extension and MotionPlus flags, builtin MotionPlus and pass-through modes; initialization distinguishes standalone,Nunchuk and Classic pass-through mappings.

applicability.revision: Original Remote and integrated Plus kept distinct where named
applicability.scope: Consumer evidence only: hid-wiimote.h:36-45,85-101; hid-wiimote-core.c:469-556. Integrated gyro and external pass-through are not interchangeable device revisions.
